extraction.name: EgoLife
extraction.description: EgoLife is a comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation. The dataset was collected over a seven-day period with six volunteers residing in a custom-designed environment (EgoHouse), each wearing Meta Aria glasses to capture multimodal egocentric videos. It is augmented with synchronized third-person perspectives from 15 GoPro cameras and two mmWave devices. The dataset supports EgoLifeQA, a suite of long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks designed to provide meaningful assistance in daily life.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team (LMMs-Lab, NTU S-Lab, and collaborators)
extraction.citeAs: The EgoLife Team. EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant. arXiv:2503.03803v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The EgoLife dataset was collected over a seven-day period with six volunteers residing in a custom-designed environment called the EgoHouse. Each participant wore Meta Aria glasses and captured multimodal egocentric videos for approximately 8 hours daily during waking hours. 15 strategically placed GoPro cameras recorded participants' activities from third-person perspectives, and millimeter-wave radars provided spatial and motion data. Participants organized an Earth Day party on the second-to-last day, engaging in activities including meetings, rehearsals, cooking, decorating, shopping, and sightseeing. Recordings were structured into three-hour segments with glasses collected every three hours for data upload.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Direct measurement, Experiments
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data includes egocentric video from 6 Meta Aria glasses (video, audio, IMU, gaze), third-person video from 15 GoPro cameras, and spatial/motion data from 2 mmWave radar devices (TI IWR6843). The Milan subset also includes WiFi CSI data from three Asus RT-AX82U devices.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Seven-day period for the Beijing session; one-day session for the Milan subset. Specific dates not stated.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Videos were synchronized across multi-source data (Aria glasses and GoPro cameras) using the EgoSync codebase. Audio tracks from six participants were merged into one for initial transcription, then split back into six tracks for per-participant transcripts. Videos were split into 5-minute clips and slowed to 0.8x speed for annotation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The pipeline synchronizes multi-source data (video, audio, IMU) from Aria glasses and GoPro cameras using EgoSync, processes them through privacy protection (EgoBlur for face blurring and license plate blurring), dense captioning (EgoCaption), and transcription (EgoTranscript) modules. Sensitive audio segments were muted, and sensitive screen content was blurred. Recordings were structured into three-hour segments for storage.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcript annotation: After synchronization, speech recognition (Whisper) and a diarization algorithm produced preliminary timestamped transcripts, which were reviewed for accuracy and split into six speaker tracks. Caption annotation: Videos were split into 5-minute clips at 0.8x speed; annotators provided continuous detailed narrations covering actions, interactions, and environmental details. Narrations (361K brief phrases, avg 2.65s) were merged using GPT-4o-mini into 25K merged captions, then expanded with representative frames and transcripts into visual-audio captions verified by human annotators. EgoLifeQA annotation: GPT-4o generated ~100K timestamped question candidates per participant across five types (EntityLog, EventRecall, HabitInsight, RelationMap, TaskMaster); annotators filtered to 1K high-quality questions per participant, refined to final 500 QA per participant (3K total), with distractors and audio/certificate length annotations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: CapCut (ByteDance) video editing software with dubbing functions was used for caption annotation. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini were used for automated caption merging and QA candidate generation. Whisper was used for speech recognition, and an open-source diarization algorithm for speaker differentiation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: AI-generated questions served as a filtering and inspiration tool for annotators rather than final annotations. Only questions requiring information from at least five minutes prior were retained, with preference for those demanding longer dependencies and strong real-world relevance. Final filtering reduced 100K candidates to less than 1% (500 per participant). Annotators verified visual-audio captions and generated distractors for multiple-choice questions.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 500 QA per participant (3,000 total); one annotation per caption verified by human annotators.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Whisper (speech recognition), open-source diarization algorithm, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini (caption merging, visual-audio caption generation, QA candidate generation), EgoBlur (face/license plate blurring), EgoSync (synchronization codebase).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to expand the dataset to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities. A one-day English-language session has already been conducted in Milan, to be detailed in upcoming EgoLife blog series.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains sensitive human attributes including language (Chinese, English, Italian), faces, voices, and personal daily activities of six participants. All participant faces and bystanders' faces were blurred, vehicle license plates were blurred, sensitive audio segments were muted, and sensitive screen content (passwords, personal data) was masked. Informed consent was obtained from all participants.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The development of EgoButler and EgoLifeQA has potential to enhance human-AI interaction through personalized assistance and context-aware applications, supporting daily activities, personal organization, and contextual reminders for individuals including the elderly or those with cognitive challenges. In educational and professional settings, it could facilitate learning, task tracking, and skill development. Privacy and ethical considerations are essential to ensure user autonomy and trust as the technology integrates into personal spaces.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is limited in generalizability due to its narrow setting: primarily a single language (Chinese), single scenario (shared house for Earth Day celebration preparation), and six participants. EgoGPT fine-tuned on EgoLife Day-1 tends to overfit to early observations (e.g., misidentifying different people wearing similar-colored clothing as the same individual).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: EgoGPT's speech understanding remains incomplete—it struggles to understand human laughter and emotions due to reliance on ASR-trained data. Identity recognition is a challenge with personalization overfitting to Day-1 observations. EgoRAG's retrieval mechanism lacks multi-step reasoning; it performs single-pass search without iterative refinement, prone to failure when relevant information is missing. The dataset has limited language coverage (primarily Chinese) and narrow scenario coverage. Due to storage limitations, recordings are structured into three-hour segments with collection breaks.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning. Use cases include: developing egocentric AI assistants, long-context life-oriented question answering (EntityLog for object details, EventRecall for past events, HabitInsight for personal habits, RelationMap for interpersonal interactions, TaskMaster for task assignment), multimodal egocentric video understanding, identity-aware questioning, habit discovery, and interpersonal interaction pattern analysis. The dataset also supports research in synchronized human behaviors, ego-exo alignment, and multimodal signal analysis (radar, WiFi).
